summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about optimizing GitHub Actions usage and addressing challenges related to column update file representation and metadata.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes.
ASF requests Iceberg to reduce GitHub Actions consumption due to usage limits.
Discussions on column update file representation and metadata tracking.
Community debates Flink version support for the upcoming Iceberg release.
